item.title: The Zero Trust Mindset: Engineering Security as an Architecture, Not a Product
item.description: Learn why Zero Trust is an architectural approach, not a product. Discover how user and device verification, continuous access control, and modern IT security work beyond VPN and firewalls.

item.title: IT Infrastructure Is Not a Collection of Products — It's a System
item.description: Most IT infrastructure projects fail not because of bad products, but because the environment never becomes a system. This foundational article sets the architectural baseline for the Core Network series.
